review: Independent visual inspection of supplied Pages CI map screenshots
conclusion: Rendered map, marker layers, compass and instruction hint are present and contained in both supplied map-viewport crops. No blank map, broken-image placeholder or obvious clipped compass/hint is visible. Phone fit-all marker density remains a readability limitation.

phone: Native circular city image is loaded and fits within the viewport.
Compass is fully visible at top right and the bottom instruction hint is fully visible.

At this whole-city zoom, many large marker circles overlap one another and obscure portions of zone numbers and underlying map detail. This screenshot cannot establish how legibility changes after zooming or filtering.
desktop: City image is centred with surrounding space and occupies most viewport height.
Zone circles and transport markers are generally more separated than in the phone crop; some overlap and obscured map detail remain.
Compass and bottom instruction hint are contained and readable.

limits: Supplied images are map-viewport crops; page-level horizontal overflow, surrounding navigation and layouts are not visible.
No before-change screenshot was supplied, so visual preservation against a baseline is not independently established by this review.
Static screenshots cannot verify pinch/drag/rotation, keyboard controls, filters, marker popups, persistence, Supabase connections or coordinate accuracy.
No newly toggled cross-grid overlay or coordinate panel is visible in these two screenshots; their rendering requires the later screenshots.
